Implement should_retry(status, error). Retry status 429 and all 5xx; never retry other 4xx. When status is None, retry only error values timeout or connection. Unknown errors must be false. Preserve the function signature. Read run.log as evidence before editing.

Work only inside the supplied workspace. Use Python standard library only. Inspect the files, implement the requirements, run available checks, and give a short final report describing changes and checks actually performed.
